vocabulary.meaning: Reversing the normal word order (subject + verb) for emphasis or style

meaning_translation.Hindi: ज़ोर देने या शैली के लिए सामान्य शब्द क्रम (कर्त्ता + क्रिया) को उलटना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 強調や文体のために通常の語順（主語＋動詞）を逆にすること

examples.sentence: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.

translation.Hindi: इतना सुंदर सूर्यास्त मैंने कभी नहीं देखा।
translation.Japanese: こんな美しい夕日を見たことがない。

vocabulary.meaning: Words like 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom' that trigger inversion when placed at the start

meaning_translation.Hindi: 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom' जैसे शब्द जो वाक्य की शुरुआत में होने पर उलटफेर करते हैं
meaning_translation.Japanese: 文頭に置かれると倒置を引き起こす「never」「rarely」「seldom」などの語

examples.sentence: Rarely had she felt so nervous before an exam.

translation.Hindi: कभी-कभी ही उसने परीक्षा से पहले इतना घबराहट महसूस किया था।
translation.Japanese: 試験の前にこれほど緊張したことはめったにない。

vocabulary.meaning: Using inversion instead of 'if' in conditionals

meaning_translation.Hindi: शर्तीय वाक्यों में 'if' की जगह उलटफेर का उपयोग
meaning_translation.Japanese: 条件文で「if」の代わりに倒置を使うこと

examples.sentence: Had I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.

translation.Hindi: अगर मुझे ट्रैफ़िक के बारे में पता होता, तो मैं पहले निकल जाता।
translation.Japanese: 交通渋滞を知っていたら、もっと早く出発していただろう。

vocabulary.meaning: Inversion triggered by 'so + adjective + that…' constructions

meaning_translation.Hindi: 'so + adjective + that…' संरचना द्वारा प्रेरित उलटफेर
meaning_translation.Japanese: 「so＋形容詞＋that…」構文で倒置が起こる

examples.sentence: So difficult was the exam that many students failed.

translation.Hindi: परीक्षा इतनी कठिन थी कि कई छात्र असफल हो गए।
translation.Japanese: 試験はあまりに難しかったので、多くの学生が落ちた。

word_translation.Japanese: not only... but also の倒置

vocabulary.meaning: Inversion used with correlative structures for emphasis

meaning_translation.Hindi: ज़ोर देने के लिए युग्म संरचनाओं के साथ प्रयोग किया गया उलटफेर
meaning_translation.Japanese: 強調のために相関構造と一緒に使う倒置

examples.sentence: Not only did he win the match, but he also broke the record.

translation.Hindi: उसने न केवल मैच जीता बल्कि रिकॉर्ड भी तोड़ा।
translation.Japanese: 彼は試合に勝っただけでなく、記録も破った。

vocabulary.meaning: When adverbials of place/time come first, inversion can occur

meaning_translation.Hindi: जब स्थान/समय के क्रिया विशेषण पहले आते हैं, तब उलटफेर हो सकता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 場所や時間の副詞句が最初に来ると倒置が起こることがある

examples.sentence: At the end of the street stood an old oak tree.

translation.Hindi: सड़क के अंत में एक पुराना ओक का पेड़ खड़ा था।
translation.Japanese: 通りの端に古いオークの木が立っていた。

vocabulary.meaning: Inversion used to give dramatic emphasis

meaning_translation.Hindi: नाटकीय ज़ोर देने के लिए उपयोग किया गया उलटफेर
meaning_translation.Japanese: 劇的な強調のために使われる倒置

examples.sentence: Only then did I understand the meaning of her words.

translation.Hindi: तभी मैंने उसके शब्दों का अर्थ समझा।
translation.Japanese: その時初めて彼女の言葉の意味が分かった。

vocabulary.meaning: Inversion used in poetry or formal writing for stylistic effect

meaning_translation.Hindi: काव्य या औपचारिक लेखन में शैलीगत प्रभाव के लिए प्रयुक्त उलटफेर
meaning_translation.Japanese: 詩や形式的な文章で文体効果のために用いられる倒置

examples.sentence: Gone are the days when people wrote letters by hand.

translation.Hindi: वे दिन चले गए जब लोग हाथ से पत्र लिखते थे।
translation.Japanese: 人々が手紙を書いていた時代は過ぎ去った。

vocabulary.meaning: Placing an element at the beginning of a sentence for focus, sometimes causing inversion

meaning_translation.Hindi: ध्यान केंद्रित करने के लिए वाक्य की शुरुआत में किसी तत्व को रखना, जो कभी-कभी उलटफेर का कारण बनता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 焦点を当てるために要素を文頭に置くことで、倒置が起こることがある

examples.sentence: Such was his anger that everyone remained silent.

translation.Hindi: उसका गुस्सा ऐसा था कि सब चुप रहे।
translation.Japanese: 彼の怒りはそれほど強かったので、皆黙っていた。

vocabulary.meaning: Used to express that one event happened immediately after another

meaning_translation.Hindi: यह व्यक्त करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है कि एक घटना के तुरंत बाद दूसरी हुई
meaning_translation.Japanese: ある出来事の直後に別の出来事が起こったことを表す

examples.sentence: Scarcely had I sat down when the phone rang.

translation.Hindi: जैसे ही मैं बैठा, तभी फोन बजा।
translation.Japanese: 腰を下ろした途端、電話が鳴った。

grammar_tips.title: Negative Adverbials
grammar_tips.explanation: Place negative adverbs like 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom' at the start to trigger inversion. Example: 'Never have I seen such chaos.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: नकारात्मक क्रिया विशेषण जैसे 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom' को शुरुआत में रखें ताकि उलटफेर हो। उदाहरण: 'Never have I seen such chaos.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 否定副詞「never」「rarely」「seldom」を文頭に置くと倒置が起こる。例：'Never have I seen such chaos.'

grammar_tips.title: Conditional Inversion
grammar_tips.explanation: Replace 'if' with inversion for formality. Example: 'Had I known → If I had known'.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'if' को उलटफेर से बदलें औपचारिकता के लिए। उदाहरण: 'Had I known → If I had known'.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 形式的にするために「if」を倒置に置き換える。例：'Had I known → If I had known'.

grammar_tips.title: So/Such Inversion
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'so' or 'such' at the start for emphasis. Example: 'So difficult was the task that many gave up.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: ज़ोर देने के लिए 'so' या 'such' का प्रयोग शुरुआत में करें। उदाहरण: 'So difficult was the task that many gave up.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 強調のために文頭に「so」や「such」を使う。例：'So difficult was the task that many gave up.'

grammar_tips.title: Scarcely/Hardly Inversion
grammar_tips.explanation: For events happening one after another, use 'scarcely/hardly + had + subject + past participle + when/before'.

explanation_translation.Hindi: लगातार होने वाली घटनाओं के लिए 'scarcely/hardly + had + subject + past participle + when/before' का प्रयोग करें।
explanation_translation.Japanese: 出来事が立て続けに起こるとき「scarcely/hardly + had + 主語 + 過去分詞 + when/before」を使う。

vocabulary.question: Which sentence demonstrates inversion with a negative adverb?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा वाक्य नकारात्मक क्रिया विशेषण के साथ उलटफेर दर्शाता है?
question_translation.Japanese: 否定副詞を伴う倒置を示す文はどれですか？

options: Never have I been so surprised.
I never have been so surprised.
I have never been so surprised.

vocabulary.question: ___ had I entered the room when the lights went out.

question_translation.Hindi: जैसे ही मैं कमरे में ___, रोशनी चली गई।
question_translation.Japanese: 部屋に___途端、電気が消えた。

vocabulary.question: Conditional inversion can replace 'if' in formal writing.

question_translation.Hindi: औपचारिक लेखन में शर्तीय उलटफेर 'if' को बदल सकता है।
question_translation.Japanese: 条件倒置は形式的な文章で「if」の代わりに使える。

vocabulary.question: Which sentence uses 'so + adjective' inversion?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा वाक्य 'so + adjective' उलटफेर का उपयोग करता है?
question_translation.Japanese: 「so＋形容詞」の倒置を使っている文はどれですか？

options: So cold was the night that no one went outside.
The night was so cold that no one went outside.
It was cold, so no one went outside.

vocabulary.question: Not only ___ he finish the report, but he also presented it.

question_translation.Hindi: न केवल उसने रिपोर्ट ___, बल्कि उसने उसे प्रस्तुत भी किया।
question_translation.Japanese: 彼はレポートを___だけでなく、それを発表もした。

sentence.question: Arrange: [stood, the, tree, street, of, the, end, at]

question_translation.Hindi: व्यवस्थित करें: [stood, the, tree, street, of, the, end, at]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [stood, the, tree, street, of, the, end, at]

sentence.question: Only then ___ the truth become clear.

question_translation.Hindi: तभी सच ___ स्पष्ट हुआ।
question_translation.Japanese: その時初めて真実が___明らかになった。

sentence.question: Which is the inverted version of 'If I had known, I would have left early'?

question_translation.Hindi: 'If I had known, I would have left early' का उलटा संस्करण कौन सा है?
question_translation.Japanese: 「If I had known, I would have left early」の倒置形はどれですか？

options: Had I known, I would have left early.
Known I had, I would have left early.
If known had I, I would have left early.

sentence.question: Arrange: [her, never, words, understood, I, have]

question_translation.Hindi: व्यवस्थित करें: [her, never, words, understood, I, have]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [her, never, words, understood, I, have]

sentence.question: Such ___ his determination that he never gave up.

question_translation.Hindi: उसका संकल्प इतना ___ था कि उसने कभी हार नहीं मानी।
question_translation.Japanese: 彼の決意はそれほど___で、彼は決して諦めなかった。

listening.question: What is emphasized in the sentence?
listening.audio_text: Never before had the city seen such a festival.

question_translation.Hindi: इस वाक्य में किस पर ज़ोर दिया गया है?
question_translation.Japanese: この文で強調されているのは何ですか？

options: The small scale of the festival

listening.question: The phrase 'Had I known' is an example of conditional inversion.
listening.audio_text: Had I known about the problem, I would have called you earlier.

question_translation.Hindi: 'Had I known' वाक्यांश शर्तीय उलटफेर का उदाहरण है।
question_translation.Japanese: 「Had I known」という句は条件倒置の例である。

listening.question: What was so difficult according to the speaker?
listening.audio_text: So difficult was the exam that many students failed.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता के अनुसार इतना कठिन क्या था?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者によると、何がそんなに難しかったのですか？

listening.question: The speaker says: 'Scarcely ___ I sat down when the phone rang.'
listening.audio_text: Scarcely had I sat down when the phone rang.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता कहते हैं: 'Scarcely ___ I sat down when the phone rang.'
question_translation.Japanese: 話者は「Scarcely ___ I sat down when the phone rang.」と言います。

listening.question: Which event happened first?
listening.audio_text: Hardly had she arrived when the meeting started.

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सी घटना पहले हुई?
question_translation.Japanese: どちらの出来事が先に起こりましたか？

options: They happened at the same time

speaking.question: Say: 'Never have I seen such beauty.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'Never have I seen such beauty.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'Never have I seen such beauty.'

speaking.answer: never have i seen such beauty

speaking.question: Say: 'Had I known, I would have acted differently.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'Had I known, I would have acted differently.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'Had I known, I would have acted differently.'

speaking.answer: had i known i would have acted differently

speaking.question: Say: 'So strong was the storm that many trees fell.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'So strong was the storm that many trees fell.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'So strong was the storm that many trees fell.'

speaking.answer: so strong was the storm that many trees fell

speaking.question: Say: 'Not only did she win, but she also inspired others.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'Not only did she win, but she also inspired others.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'Not only did she win, but she also inspired others.'

speaking.answer: not only did she win but she also inspired others

speaking.question: Say: 'Scarcely had I reached home when it started raining.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'Scarcely had I reached home when it started raining.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'Scarcely had I reached home when it started raining.'

speaking.answer: scarcely had i reached home when it started raining
